{{Top}}
[[File:Narloch1.jpg|thumb|right|200px|The [[Herglic/Legends|Herglics]] were a cetacean species.]]
'''Cetaceans''', also known as '''sea mammals''', were a subgroup of [[Water/Legends|aquatic]] or marine [[Mammal/Legends|mammals]]. They were usually typified by a predominance of several traits, including a [[Hair/Legends|hairless]] or nearly hairless body, a flat, notched tail, anterior flipper-like limbs, and vestigial posterior limbs.<ref name="NEGAS">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref> Many cetaceans also filtered [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] through the sieve-plates in their baleen.<ref name="DB">{{DB|creature|aiwha|aiwha}}</ref> Additionally, their nostrils could close, with their large [[Lung/Legends|lungs]] allowing them to stay underwater for several [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] at a time.<ref name="NEGAS" /> Both the [[Porporite]]<ref name="The New Essential Guide to Droids">''[[The New Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref> and [[Herglic/Legends|Herglic]] [[Species/Legends|species]] were [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] cetaceans.<ref name="The Essential Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> Non-sentient cetacean species included the [[Aiwha/Legends|aiwha]] of [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] and [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].<ref name="DB" />
